title: Field rules
description: field/rules.yaml of the game pack: player movement and partner following (game/field, docs/reference/campo.md). Distances in world units (100 = one collision cell), speeds per second, turn speeds in radians per second.

run_distance.description: In partner radii: beyond it runs.

walk_distance.description: In partner radii: beyond it walks, closer it stops.

spawn_distance.description: Distance from the player when entering a map.

trail_length.description: Most player cells remembered while the partner cannot see the player.

sight_half_width.description: Half width of the corridor that must be free to see the player.

stuck_seconds.description: Time without progress before the partner is placed behind the player.

teleport_distance.description: Farther than this, the partner is placed behind the player.

dead_zone.description: Stick vectors shorter than this are no movement.

arrive_distance.description: Click-to-move: stopped by a wall this close to the clicked point counts as arrived.

model.description: Asset id of the .glb drawn for it.

radius.description: Collision size: the probe reaches radius ahead and radius / 2 to the sides.

turn_speed.description: How fast the facing turns; 0 = at once.
